label: Saint Joseph, Husband of the Virgin Mary (Gregorian Missal)

chants.vernacular_text: The righteous man shall flourish like the palm tree; he shall grow up like the cedar of Lebanon; for he is planted in the house of the Lord, in the courts of our God. ℣. It is good to give praise to the Lord; and to sing in honour of your name, O Most High.
O Lord, you have gone ahead to meet him with goodly blessings; you have placed a crown of precious stones on his head. ℣. He asked you for life, and you granted him length of days for ever and ever.

Blessed is the man who fears the Lord; he shall delight exceedingly in his commandments. ℣. His seed shall be mighty upon earth; the descendants of the righteous will be blessed. ℣. Glory and wealth are in his house; and his righteousness endures for ever.
My fidelity and my mercy are with him; and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
Joseph, son of David, fear not to receive Mary as your wife; for that which is conceived in her comes from the Holy Spirit.
My son, why have you treated us so? Your father and I have been anxiously looking for you. How is it that you were seeking me? Did you not know that I must be about my Father's business?
